gloss: to pluck; to pull out; to tear off

definitions.gloss: to pluck; to pull out; to pick off in pieces
definitions.explanation: To grab and pull out something growing or attached, such as weeds, grass, feathers, or hair, usually a handful at a time. Also to tear small pieces off something, such as the flesh of a cooked fish or a piece of bread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧むしって⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I picked the flesh off the grilled fish with chopsticks and ate it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧むしって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: My back hurts because I spent all day pulling weeds in the garden.

notes:
Usually written in kana; the kanji spelling is rare.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive
- Pattern: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むしる (to pluck or pull out ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むしる / ⟦{草|くさ}むしり→草むしり：08195_kusamushiri⟧: to weed / weeding
- {羽|はね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むしる: to pluck feathers
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かきむしる: to tear at one's hair (in frustration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to pull out — general, often one thing cleanly; むしる is grabbing and tearing, often many at once
- ⟦{摘|つ}む→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧: to pick (flowers, tea leaves) — gently, with the fingertips
